COMICCHESS-SOUL_LAMP_POWER.title: Soul Lamp
COMICCHESS-SOUL_LAMP_POWER.description: As long as you have [aqua]Soul Lamp[/aqua], all [gold]Bound[/gold] cards ignore the [gold]Binding Oath[/gold] limit and can be played for free. Each time you manually play a [gold]Bound[/gold] card, consume [blue]1[/blue] stack of [aqua]Soul Lamp[/aqua].
COMICCHESS-BINDING_OATH_POWER.title: Binding Oath
COMICCHESS-BINDING_OATH_POWER.descriptio: Each turn you can only play [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Bound[/gold] card.
